item.title: Accepting US car standards would risk European lives
item.description:
📝 “Europe built its reputation on pioneering robust vehicle standards. To accept lower US standards would undo decades of EU progress,” say the signatories. To now accept lower US vehicle standards across the board would open the floodgates to US pick-ups and large SUVs.
🔗 Read more: https://etsc.eu/accepting-us-car-standards-would-risk-european-lives-warn-cities-and-civil-society/

item.title: Zig quits GitHub, says Microsoft's AI obsession has ruined the service
item.description:
📝 The drama began in April 2025 when GitHub user AlekseiNikiforovIBM started a thread titled “safe_sleep. ” GitHub addressed the problem in August, but didn’t reveal that in the thread, which remained open until Monday. It was supposed to allow the GitHub Actions runner – the application that runs a job from a GitHub Actions workflow – to pause execution safely.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theregister.com/2025/12/02/zig_quits_github_microsoft_ai_obsession/

item.title: Researchers Find Microbe Capable of Producing Oxygen from Martian Soil
item.description:
📝 Researchers tested this by using soil that mimics Martian regolith. This resilience is what defines them as extremophiles, organisms that have evolved to survive where most others cannot. Using microbes for oxygen production could become one part of that system.
🔗 Read more: https://scienceclock.com/microbe-that-could-turn-martian-dust-into-oxygen/
